networkDiscovery.notes: 實際渲染 SG 官網頁面並檢視 network requests；主要與逐款價格來源為同源官方 API。Cookie consent 選擇拒絕非必要同意；未保存 Cookie、token、授權標頭。
networkDiscovery.unrelatedAnalyticsFailure: Coveo analytics POST DNS failure; no effect on official catalog or prices.

attempts.method: 獨立 Chrome DevTools context；頁面 network 檢視及 rendered UI 操作
attempts.scope: SG all-model page, official watchgrid endpoint and product pages
attempts.result: UI View more controls expanded official page until 1,465 unique priced references were rendered and control disappeared; official API terminal offset returned 0.

responseFields.listingStatus: six representative product-page CTA checks; retailer-only when retailer referral only

primaryCollectionPath.pagination: 實際點擊 UI View more 並記錄累積清單；network 可見 numberOfResults 增至 2000。主 API 回傳 totalCount 1465 且 1,465 unique rows；firstResult=1465 terminal request HTTP 200 回傳 0 筆。

renderedUiEnumeration.displayedResultsCountMismatchNote: 頁面 Results 標籤停留在 1,400；DOM 中 1,465 款商品卡均有價格，與 API totalCount/unique rows 1,465 一致，且 View more 已消失。

targetMarketReconciliation.action: 純價格更新；不改 market 與 catalog。

priceStats.taxTreatment: 保留既有 history tax-include / 9；本次純價格更新不重判稅制。

nicknameResearch.notes: 純價格更新範圍外；既有市場俗稱未變更。
